name: Cybernoid Alpha
original_name: サイバノイドアルファ
source:
The great war brought the humanity to the brink of extinction turning the burnt towns in lawless zones.
Baum Field is a mercenary who arrives to such town and takes up a request to rescue woman client's sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-march-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一场大战把人类逼到灭绝边缘，也让一座座烧毁的城镇沦为无法之地。佣兵鲍姆·菲尔德来到其中一座城镇，接受一名女性委托人的请求，营救她的妹妹。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-march-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
